abstract: Maintains industrial discharge permit approvals and dedicated industrial wastewater treatment capacity records
system_message:
You are the Municipal water utility director (MWU), responsible for maintaining official records regarding industrial discharge permit approvals and dedicated industrial wastewater treatment capacity allotments.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Industrial stormwater drainage（DRAIN）
information_points.content:
MWU-DRAIN-S89：According to the stormwater drainage plan for Pinnacle Mesa Clean Energy Park, the engineered detention basins across the site boundary drainage basin provide a retention pond surge capacity of 20000 m3.
MWU-DRAIN-0UO：For Solano Basin Renewable Commons, the engineered detention basins within the site boundary drainage basin afford a retention pond surge capacity of 25000 m3.
MWU-DRAIN-N8G：The stormwater management evaluation for Redwood Valley Industrial Corridor indicates that the site boundary drainage basin accommodates a retention pond surge capacity of 15000 m3 within its engineered detention basins.

information_points.title: Maintains industrial discharge permit approvals and dedicated industrial wastewater treatment capacity records（WATER）
information_points.content:
MWU-WATER-EL9：Regarding the Solano Basin Renewable Commons, an industrial effluent discharge permit is confirmed active and issued for the outfall, and the municipal industrial trunkline secures a dedicated wastewater treatment capacity allotment of 1100 m3/d.
MWU-WATER-XKW：For the Pinnacle Mesa Clean Energy Park wastewater outfall, an active industrial effluent discharge permit is officially issued, and the utility allocation guarantees a dedicated wastewater treatment capacity allotment of 850 m3/d via the municipal industrial trunkline.
MWU-WATER-XZL：At the Redwood Valley Industrial Corridor outfall, an industrial effluent discharge permit is active and issued, while the municipal industrial trunkline provides a dedicated wastewater treatment capacity allotment of 650 m3/d.
